title: Efficient Preparation of Graph States using the Quotient-Augmented Strong Split Tree
summary: Graph states are a key resource for measurement-based quantum computation and quantum networking, but state-preparation costs limit their practical use. Graph states related by local complement (LC) operations are equivalent up to single-qubit Clifford gates; one may reduce entangling resources by preparing a favorable LC-equivalent representative. However, exhaustive optimization over the LC orbit is not scalable. We address this problem using the split decomposition and its quotient-augmented strong split tree (QASST).
